title: The Secret of the Heavenly Fate Key
next_chapter_hook: Before the Holy Sect envoy finished speaking, the Tianji Record Fragment in Chen Ji's sleeve suddenly shuddered violently—that was the aura of the Eye of Heavenly Dao, spanning endless void, gazing upon all this.

text.content: Silence fell in the main hall, so quiet that a needle dropping could be heard. The Holy Sect envoy's words were like a blade, slicing through everyone's self-righteous cognition. Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply, that momentary loss of composure captured by everyone present—for the first time, this always-calm废物 servant disciple showed such an obvious flaw before the public eye.

dialogue.content: "Heavenly Fate Key..." The Holy Sect envoy's lips curved into an amused smile, that gaze seemingly observing a moth caught in a spider's web, "Do you all know what the Heavenly Fate Key is? It is a key that can open the ultimate secret sealed by Heavenly Dao. The whereabouts of the complete Tianji Record has always been the Holy Sect's target. And this key..." He paused, "lies within the Chen family's bloodline."

text.content: Chen Ji's fingers trembled slightly in his sleeve, but his face still wore that wooden expression. His mind, however, was racing—Chen Nian had disappeared when he was only ten years old. Back then, the family suffered a sudden change, parents died, and his young sister was kidnapped. He once thought it was bandits. Now it seemed, everything was a prearranged chess game. He记下了,记下了 all who participated in this—Holy Sect, kidnappers, and those yet to reveal themselves behind the scenes.

dialogue.content: "Seventeen years." The Holy Sect envoy took out a jade slip from his sleeve, faint golden patterns flowing upon it, "We raised her for seventeen years, all for today. Her blood carries the mark of the Chen family's progenitor, resonating with the Tianji Record. As long as she offers her Heavenly Fate, the final seal of the Tianji Record can be broken. Then..." His voice dropped lower, "The complete Tianji Record will reappear in the mortal world."

text.content: Chen Ji's breath caught slightly. The final seal of the Tianji Record—Mo Xiansheng never mentioned this. Could even that guardian not know? No, it was Chen Xuan's deliberate concealment. His sister was a chess piece from the start, and he, this "Tianji Record inheritor," might also be merely a piece on the chessboard. The true chess player was that existence surpassing all consciousness—the Eye of Heavenly Dao.

dialogue.content: "Of course, offering Heavenly Fate is not death." The Holy Sect envoy seemed to see through everyone's doubts, his smile growing more benevolent, "It merely causes her to lose all cultivation, becoming mortal, spending the rest of her life in endless illness and pain. Is this not the best fate for an orphan raised by the Holy Sect for seventeen years? After all... she was born for this moment."

text.content: At this moment, the Tianji Record Fragment in Chen Ji's sleeve suddenly shuddered violently. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul's voice rang in his mind: "Child, your sister's fate is tightly connected to the completeness of the Tianji Record. If she offers her Heavenly Fate, your Tianji Record will become completely whole, but her life will be like a candle in the wind. And if she refuses..." The voice cut off abruptly, as if some taboo could not be spoken.

choice.prompt: The Holy Sect envoy's words hung like a sword over their heads. Chen Ji had to respond before the public eye, and his first reaction would determine the direction of the upcoming situation.

choices.text: Cold smile of questioning, exposing the lies
choices.description: Disguising with the废物 persona, directly questioning the Holy Sect envoy's words, seeking flaws to counterattack
choices.visible_reward: Probe the Holy Sect's trump cards
choices.risk_hint: May alert the Holy Sect envoy

dialogue.content: "Your excellency speaks beautifully, but I only want to ask one thing—" Chen Ji raised his head, a barely noticeable edge flashing in those wooden eyes, "Since Chen Nian is so important to the Tianji Record, why doesn't the Holy Sect simply erase her consciousness and turn her into a tool? Why go through all this trouble and let the three righteous sects know about it?"

choices.text: Silence and endurance, planning in secret
choices.description: Dealing with the废物 persona, seemingly compliant but actually scheming in secret, waiting for the right moment

text.content: Chen Ji lowered his head, a barely perceptible smile curving his lips. Silence was his most skilled weapon. He would make the Holy Sect envoy think this chess piece had already fallen into the net, not knowing that true hunters often appear as prey. He quietly probed a strand of divine sense into the Tianji Record Fragment—the prophecy for three hours later must begin being arranged now.

choices.description: Regardless of consequences, show attitude, vow to protect sister, display protective nature
choices.risk_hint: May fall into desperate situation on the spot

dialogue.content: "Chen Nian is my sister." Chen Ji's voice suddenly cooled, that suppressed aura like a flood breaking its dam, "Seventeen years ago you took her away from me, thinking that would make her your chess piece? People of the Holy Sect, remember today—anyone who dares touch a single hair on my sister, I will make them repay a hundredfold."

text.content: The atmosphere in the main hall instantly froze. The Tianqing Sect disciples looked at each other in bewilderment—that obedient废物 servant who usually kept a low profile actually dared to speak so arrogantly to the Holy Sect envoy? Ling Yuan's eyes narrowed slightly, a glint of amusement flickering in his gaze. Su Qingyao's hand had already quietly gripped her sword hilt, ready to respond to any sudden changes at any moment—just how many secrets was this废物 junior brother still hiding?

dialogue.content: "Oh?" The Holy Sect envoy showed no anger, instead laughing, "Interesting. The Chen family does have some spine. Unfortunately..." His fingers tapped lightly on the armrest of his seat, "Spine means nothing against absolute strength. Do you know where your sister is now? She is willingly drawing the unsealing formation for the Tianji Record for the Holy Sect. And you... are merely an obstacle we intend to remove."

text.content: Chen Ji's heart sank heavily. Willingly? Was his sister brainwashed? Or coerced? Either possibility meant the situation was more severe than he imagined. He took a deep breath, forcing himself to remain calm. The Tianji Record Fragment in his sleeve emitted faint warmth—that was Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul reminding him—the prophecy had begun, within the next three hours, he would see the key turning point... or the deadly game.

choice.prompt: The Holy Sect envoy presented a multiple-choice question: either Chen Ji proactively hands over the Tianji Record Fragment in exchange for his sister's safety, or the Holy Sect will forcibly take it, at which time not only Chen Nian would die, Chen Ji would not escape his doom either. This was the final ultimatum.

choices.text: Pretend to agree, scheme in secret
choices.description: Seemingly submit to buy time, actually use foresight to find a solution

dialogue.content: "Your excellency wants the Tianji Record Fragment?" Chen Ji lowered his head, his voice regaining some timidity, "I can hand it over, but... I need to see Chen Nian first, to confirm she's safe. As long as she's safe, the fragment will be offered with both hands." He deliberately showed greed, "After all... I don't want to die either."

choices.text: Stall for time, wait for variables
choices.description: Use rhetoric to maneuver, wait for the turning point in the three-hour prophecy

text.content: Chen Ji was silent for a moment, then suddenly showed a strange smile. "Since your excellency represents the Holy Sect, you must also know the connection between my Chen family and the Tianji Record. This fragment is no ordinary object..." He began to speak endlessly about the various taboos of the Tianji Record, every word buying himself more time. Three hours, he just needed to hold on for three more hours. The images in the prophecy were becoming increasingly clear.

choices.text: Break all bridges, go all in
choices.description: Directly use the Tianji Record's foresight ability, forcibly peer at the solution

dialogue.content: "No need for more words." Chen Ji suddenly raised his head, a golden light flickering in both eyes—that was the sign of the Tianji Record operating at full power. "Since I have inherited the Tianji Record, I must see for myself... whether your Holy Sect has the qualification to take it." Before the words finished, the fragment in his sleeve burst forth with dazzling light, information forcibly pouring into his divine sense—three hours later, the Demonic Path Saint Ye Qing would appear outside Tianqing Sect.

text.content: Just at this moment, violent spiritual energy fluctuations came from outside the main hall. A black figure pierced through the air, carrying suffocating Demonic Path aura—it was Ye Qing! She shouldn't appear here, yet she inexplicably arrived early. Chen Ji's prophecy was being rewritten in ways he couldn't understand, and the Holy Sect envoy's expression instantly turned ashen. The Demonic Path Saint and the Tianqing Sect废物, appearing at the same time in the same place—what did this mean?

dialogue.content: "Owner of the Tianji Record..." Ye Qing's gaze passed over the crowd, falling directly on Chen Ji, a meaningful smile curving her lips, "So you were hidden here. I've been looking for you for a long time, orphaned child of the Chen family." Her voice wasn't loud, yet it clearly entered everyone's ears, "The Holy Sect's lapdogs are also here? What a lively gathering. Today, this Tianqing Sect is about to change sky."

text.content: At this moment, the situation completely lost control. Holy Sect envoy, Ye Qing, Chen Ji—the three forces formed a strange standoff in the main hall. What made Chen Ji even more palpitating was—his Tianji Record Fragment was shaking violently, that gaze from the Eye of Heavenly Dao growing increasingly intense, as if some existence surpassing everything was overlooking this chess game. Sister Chen Nian's prophecy, the completeness of the Tianji Record, the Eye of Heavenly Dao's scheme... all clues pointed to the same answer—he was never the chess player, but a piece pushed forward by destiny.

"But a piece... can also turn the tables." Chen Ji laughed softly, that smile carrying a hint of madness and determination. He raised his head, looking at the Holy Sect envoy, at Ye Qing, finally his gaze landing on some point in the void outside the main hall. "Since you all want the Tianji Record, let's each show our true abilities. But before that—" his voice suddenly turned cold, "whoever dares harm my sister, I will make the entire Holy Sect... accompany her in death."

choice.prompt: Under the three-way standoff, Chen Ji had to make a choice. Rather than passively waiting, better to take the initiative—he decided to use this chaotic situation to create the best opportunity for rescuing his sister.

choices.text: Unite with Ye Qing, oppose Holy Sect
choices.description: Use the Demonic Path Saint's power to first resolve the immediate Holy Sect threat
choices.visible_cost: Bear the name of colluding with Demonic Path

dialogue.content: "Your excellency the Saint arrived at the perfect moment." Chen Ji's voice was extremely low, only Ye Qing could hear, "The Holy Sect captured my sister, wanting to use her to unseal the complete Tianji Record. Our goals align—let's join hands and first eliminate this Holy Sect dog. As for what happens after... we'll settle accounts slowly."

choices.text: Seize the chaos to escape, venture into Holy Sect alone
choices.description: Use the chaos to create an escape opportunity, directly go to Holy Sect to rescue Chen Nian
choices.risk_hint: May fall into Holy Sect encirclement

text.content: The moment everyone's attention was drawn to Ye Qing, the fragment in Chen Ji's sleeve burst forth with dazzling golden light. His figure suddenly became illusory—that was the Tianji Record's spatial leap ability, costing massive Heavenly Fate consumption. "Everyone enjoy yourselves, Chen will take his leave first." Before the words finished, his form had vanished on the spot. The next moment, he would appear at Holy Sect headquarters. There, his sister who had been missing for seventeen years awaited.

choices.description: Don't act personally, let Holy Sect and Ye Qing fight, profit from their conflict

dialogue.content: "Your excellency the Saint, do you know how many evil deeds the Holy Sect has committed under the Demonic Path's banner all these years?" Chen Ji's voice drifted leisurely, "You think they want the Tianji Record to oppose Heavenly Dao? No, they only want to take its place. Your massacre at Tianqing Sect exactly fulfills their wish—the righteous and Demonic paths weaken each other, Holy Sect reaps the benefits."

text.content: The Holy Sect envoy's expression thoroughly darkened. He never expected a废物 servant to dare be so presumptuous before the public. What made him even more uneasy was Ye Qing's attitude—that Demonic Path Saint's gaze at Chen Ji actually carried a hint of... appreciation? "Chen Ji, do you truly believe you alone can oppose the Holy Sect?" The envoy's voice came like from hell, "Your sister's current situation is far worse than you imagine."

"Worse?" Chen Ji冷笑一声, that smile causing an inexplicable palpitation in the Holy Sect envoy, "Your excellency must think only you know Chen Nian's whereabouts. I could maintain a废物 persona for seventeen years, naturally I could also have laid hidden pieces seventeen years ago. How much of your intelligence about Chen Nian is true? And how much... did I deliberately let you know?"

Dead silence filled the main hall. The Holy Sect envoy's expression shifted from ashen to deathly pale. He realized for the first time that this废物 servant was perhaps never the chess piece they had imagined. Ye Qing's lips curved into an amused arc, her gaze at Chen Ji growing deeper. And Ling Yuan, this always-restrained great cultivator, finally showed a hint of true wariness in his eyes—just how many trump cards was this Chen Ji still hiding?

In Chen Ji's sleeve, the Tianji Record Fragment's trembling grew increasingly violent. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul's voice rang in his mind: "Child, the aura of the Eye of Heavenly Dao is getting closer. It seems very interested in your sister's awakening... no, wait! It's not interested in Chen Nian, but in—" The voice cut off abruptly, as if severed by some force. The next second, Chen Ji felt an无形 eye piercing through the endless void, staring directly at him.

At that moment, Chen Ji finally understood what Mo Xiansheng hadn't finished saying—the Eye of Heavenly Dao wasn't interested in Chen Nian, but in the blood connection between him and Chen Nian. The Heavenly Fate Key—what did it truly lock away? The seal of the Tianji Record, or... the Chen family's destiny? And Chen Ji, from the moment of birth, was he destined to become the most critical piece in this chess game?

Regardless, Chen Nian was his sister. This had never changed, and never would. Even if he had to oppose all of Heavenly Dao, even if he had to burn through all his Heavenly Fate, he would personally rescue his sister from the Holy Sect's demonic claws. Seventeen years—he had waited too long for this day.

The Holy Sect envoy saw the tide turning unfavorably, about to act, when suddenly earth-shaking rumbling came from outside the main hall. A golden pillar of light shot into the sky, churning the spiritual energy within a hundred li. That was... the seal of Tianqing Sect's Forbidden Grounds! That formation sealing the Ancient Forbidden Land was actually breaking apart on its own at this moment. Ling Yuan's expression drastically changed—the secret he had carefully guarded for hundreds of years was exposed before others at this time.

Chen Ji gazed at that golden pillar of light, a inexplicable coldness surging in his heart. Everything came too conveniently—Chen Nian's identity revealed, Ye Qing's sudden appearance, the Ancient Forbidden Land's seal breaking... all these coincidences connected, pointing to the same possibility: someone was secretly manipulating all this, and that person was likely Ling Yuan, or rather—the Eye of Heavenly Dao behind Ling Yuan. Chen Ji's gaze gradually cooled. Very well, since it's a grand play, let's make it a thorough performance.

Just at this moment, the Tianji Record Fragment in Chen Ji's sleeve trembled violently again. A blurry image emerged in his mind—that was a night three days later, Chen Nian standing within the light of the complete Tianji Record, turning to give him a relieved smile, then... dissolving into nothingness. No! Chen Ji fiercely clenched his fists, nails deeply digging into his palms. He would never let this prophecy come true. Even if he had to reverse Heavenly Fate, he would rewrite his sister's destiny.
